title: Indi: may the Team app update the team board when someone ticks a task?
detail: Indi wants ticks in the Team app to change the real task list. Design (brief v4, step 5b, people/indi/prompts/team-app-redesign.md): each person gets a fine-grained GitHub token for this repository only (contents read and write), kept in the iPhone Keychain; a tick sets status: done on board/WS-NN files, or updates people/<id>/tasks.json, as commits 'app@web-summit.<person>: task done: <title>' on dev, debounced 20 s; phones re-read every 60 s. Each commit is also a site release.
recommend: yes, per-person tokens and app commits on dev
options: yes, per-person tokens and app commits on dev
yes, but through an agent instead (slower, no tokens on phones)
